## Philosophy & The Three Pillars
At Lumia Dental, we believe modern dental care goes beyond great trade craft. We want more than a satisfied patient: we want to ensure comfort and convenience at every step.
1. Convenience:
   - Text, phone, web, and mobile integration.
   - Paperless digital intake; zero clipboard waiting room friction.
   - Transparent cost estimates before any treatment.
2. Cutting Edge:
   - iTero 3D digital scanners eliminate impression putty.
   - Ultra-low radiation digital sensors and high-magnification surgical microscopes.
   - Clinicians trained at Tufts, UPenn, Columbia, NYU, and Temple.
3. Comfort:
   - Ceiling-mounted 4K televisions with Netflix and streaming music.
   - Noise-canceling headphones.
   - Warm scented towels and gentle bedside manner.

## All 8 Clinical Specialties
1. Cosmetic Dentistry & Porcelain Veneers:
   - Ultra-thin handcrafted porcelain veneers, Lumineers, aesthetic tooth bonding.
   - In-office laser teeth whitening.
2. Invisalign® Clear Aligners:
   - Directed by Dr. Adam Goodman, Top 1% Diamond Provider.
   - Accelerated digital orthodontic movement with SmartTrack material.
3. Pediatric Dentistry:
   - Board-Certified Pediatric Dentist Dr. Monica Lobo.
   - Infant exams, gentle cleanings, fluoride varnish, and BPA-free dental sealants.
4. Dental Implants & Periodontics:
   - Board-Certified Periodontist Dr. Vandeep Bagga.
   - Single-tooth implants, full-arch restorations, bone grafting, and sinus lifts.
5. Restorative Dentistry:
   - High-definition ceramic crowns, inlays, onlays, and tooth-colored composite restorations.
6. Endodontics (Microscopic Root Canals):
   - Specialist Endodontist Dr. Raven Drummond.
   - High-magnification painless nerve treatment for immediate toothache relief.
7. Periodontics (Gum Disease Therapy):
   - Ultrasonic scaling and root planing, laser decontamination, soft-tissue gum grafts.
8. Preventive Care:
   - Semi-annual dental examinations, oral cancer screenings, piezoelectric cleanings.

- Dr. Rebecca Gutowski (Matour), D.M.D.: B.S. Neuroscience Tulane University; Doctorate with Honors in Community Oral Health at University of Pennsylvania. Focus on anxiety-free dentistry.

- Dr. Mee Kyung (Michelle) Han, D.D.S.: Columbia University & NYU Dentistry. Founder of Lumia Dental; national lecturer on advanced digital dentistry.
- Dr. Monica Lobo, D.D.S.: Board-Certified Pediatric Dentist and New York native. Fear-free dental visits for children.
- Dr. Raven Drummond, D.D.S.: B.S. Neuroscience Emory University; D.D.S. Howard University College of Dentistry. Microscopic root canals.
- Dr. Vandeep Bagga, D.D.S.: Board-Certified Periodontist; NYU Dentistry Clinical Excellence Award. Advanced implant placement and bone grafting.
- Dr. Adam Goodman, D.M.D.: Nationally acclaimed orthodontist; Invisalign Top 1% Diamond Provider.
